_readme: ONNX Runtime GPU install candidates for Jetson. A candidate is selected ONLY by id, looked up via a VERIFIED entry in config/jetson_agx_orin_profiles.json's ort_candidate_id field (see jetson_common.resolve_ort_candidate_for_profile) -- never by matching jetpack_family/cuda_major/python_abi/arch directly against a candidate. Those fields are kept here as documentary metadata (so a human reading this file can sanity-check a candidate against its linked profile), not as an independent match key. This file ships EMPTY of real candidates on purpose: no wheel URL, filename, or version here has been verified installable/importable on a real Jetson AGX Orin from this development environment (which is x86_64 and has no ARM64 wheel to test). scripts/install_jetson_ort.py REFUSES to guess a URL for a profile with no resolvable candidate -- it reports 'no verified ORT candidate' and the caller falls back to CPU Safe Mode. To add a real candidate: on the target Jetson device, obtain the correct ARM64 ONNX Runtime GPU wheel for that exact JetPack from an official NVIDIA source (Jetson AI Lab / Jetson Zoo / NVIDIA's JetPack-matched pip index for that L4T release), add an entry below with the fields filled from what you actually installed, link it from a verified profile's ort_candidate_id, and confirm the install with `python3 scripts/verify_jetson_agx_gpu.py` before relying on it here.

candidates.notes: Placeholder. Never filled from a guess -- only from a real successful install on the target device, and only ever reached via a verified profile's ort_candidate_id.
